oracle.derivation: Converged reference: ngspice 45 run of the deck with ".options reltol=1e-7 abstol=1e-15 vntol=1e-9 method=gear" (trtol at its default) and the .tran line replaced by ".tran 0.1us 10us 0 0.05ns" (tmax 0.05 ns): 200513 accepted points. Rows: linear interpolation at the 263 sample times of the previous oracle. Agreement at the same settings (worst column, in units of the tolerances below): espice 0.29x (i(vin) at 2.53 ns), espice with tmax 0.02 ns 0.41x (i(vin) at 21 ns); ngspice 45 stops with 'timestep too small' at tmax 0.02 ns and at abstol=1e-16. The trapezoid rule converges to the same voltages (reltol=1e-7, tmax 0.05 ns: 0.25x) but not the source currents: it rings undamped in i(vin) (+-1.4e-7 A over 0.2-0.5 us around the gear value, 1.1e3x) and i(vb) (33x) at any tolerance, because both sources sit across pure capacitance (the gate of m10, the bulk junctions). Physically both settle: after 7 us i(vin) is 0 (a MOS gate draws no DC current) and i(vb) is the bulk junction leakage 9.1378e-10 A, the operating-point value; gear reproduces both, while the trapezoid rule at reltol=1e-6 holds i(vin) at +2.04e-11 A (ngspice) and -3.72e-11 A (espice), i(vb) at 8.951e-10 and 9.896e-10 A. Convergence (worst column vs this reference): gear reltol=1e-6 tmax 0.1 ns 3.2x (i(vin) at 21 ns), trtol=1 0.51x; gear reltol=3e-7 1.4x; trapezoidal reltol=1e-6 tmax 0.1 ns (the previous oracle's settings) 1.4e4x (i(vin)), 78x (i(vb)), voltages 0.13x. VACASK (spice/mos2.osdi, hand-converted netlist) settles on a different operating point (v(8) = 1266 V) and is not used.
oracle.command: ngspice -n -b -r reference.raw deck.sp  (deck with its reltol line replaced by ".options reltol=1e-7 abstol=1e-15 vntol=1e-9 method=gear", .tran -> ".tran 0.1us 10us 0 0.05ns")

notes: The deck runs gear with trtol=1 at the previous oracle's reltol=1e-6 abstol=1e-15 vntol=1e-9 and tmax 0.1 ns. The trapezoid rule cannot be scored against the circuit's answer in i(vin) and i(vb): its ringing does not shrink with the tolerances. At the deck's original options (abstol=10n vntol=10n, no tmax) ngspice 45 is 1.1e5x off this reference (i(vin)) and 1.3e3x on v(66); espice 1.5e6x and 4.9e3x, with 169 accepted points against ngspice's 2316.

Scores at the deck's options against this oracle, tolerances unchanged: ngspice 45 0.51x (i(vin) at 2.53 ns), i(vb) 0.44x, voltages 0.029x; espice 0.50x, i(vb) 0.46x, voltages 0.028x. Wrong answers fail: the trapezoidal deck 1.4e4x, gear at the default trtol 3.2x, model errors in espice at the deck's options kp +1% 8.1e3x and cc +1% 1.3e3x.
